title: Alt Right Click Suggestions Shortcut
description: When pressing alt + right click on a handle/vortex/grip in puzzle 2d, 3d and 5d, directly show the list of suggestions instead of the selection context menu.
summary: Alt+right-click on a free handle (2d) or vortex (3d) now opens the brush suggestions list directly instead of the selection context menu. Puzzle 2d passes altKey through the contextmenu event; puzzle 3d blocks Alt+right orbit over vortices and routes the gesture to puzzle3dOpenVortexSuggestionsRef. Puzzle 5d inherits both via its 2d/3d canvases.
